diagnostic_lessons: Only one J8 candidate passed Kelly >=0.05, so canonical risked MXN20 and held MXN80; no-spend pressure was respected.
Toluca ML at 1.32 had p_raw 0.82963, EV +9.51% and full-Kelly 29.72%, and won 3-1. An arbitrary odds floor of 1.40 would have excluded this positive-EV high-Kelly ticket.

Fractional Kelly does not mechanically mean smaller stakes than the fixed ladder: because Toluca's Kelly score was very high, FK15/FK20/FK25 all staked more than the canonical MXN20 and therefore earned more pesos on the same winning ticket.

América had high nominal probability but only a very thin positive EV at the frozen Caliente price and failed the Kelly gate; América then lost 1-2. This is diagnostic support for separating probability from price, not a basis for retroactive rule changes.
No parlay was created because there was only one qualifying single, demonstrating that the secondary parlay layer is conditional rather than a forced budget spend.

Raw calibration beat the shrinkage shadow on J8 and extends its cumulative J1-J8 lead, but no calibration or staking promotion is allowed from J8 because of future-information researcher exposure before selection freeze.
result_source_notes: TUDN and EL PAÍS agree on the J8 score grid used here, including Toluca 3-1 Puebla, América 1-2 Guadalajara and Querétaro 0-1 Monterrey.
